Asha (PM): Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands about timelines for Hosted API, Console improvements, and Optimize recommendations. Can leadership clarify target quarters and any dependencies?
Lee (VP Product): Short answer: Hosted API - Q2 GA for streaming perf updates; Console - iterative UX work across Q2/Q3 with a big push in mid-Q3; Optimize - beta to select customers in late Q3.
Diego (Eng): For Hosted API perf, the critical path is the kernel selection rollout + CI perf tests. ETA depends on 2 missing perf regressions we still have to squash.
Asha (PM): Diego, can you enumerate the two perf regressions and owners? We need to communicate to customers.
Diego (Eng): 1) padding/attention kernel causing 15% tail-latency spike (Sanjay's team). 2) KV-cache eviction race on cold-start (Maya). I'll open tickets.
Maya (Eng-Platform): Confirmed, I'll take the KV-cache ticket. Plan: hotfix in 2 sprints then monitor with canary.
Lee (VP Product): We should decouple the Console release from the kernel rollout — Console feature flagging will let us ship UX sooner even if we hold some perf behind flags.
Samira (DevEx): For docs + SDK updates, what's the cutover plan? We don't want docs to ship with partial APIs.
Lee (VP Product): Docs: ship API surface now as 'alpha' with clear notes; final SDK bump with GA. Samira, you'll own the alpha doc note.
Jon (CEO): Two priorities: not breaking current customers + clear migration path. If there are customers on private deployments we should coordinate release notes and migration guides.
Asha (PM): Agree. Action items: Diego to create perf tickets, Maya to track KV-cache fix, Samira to draft alpha docs, Lee to confirm feature flagging plan. I'll compile a customer-facing timeline by EOD Friday.
ops-bot: Deployment window scheduled for 2026-06-15 02:00 UTC for kernel-rollout-canary
Diego (Eng): Note — canary will be limited to 5% traffic groups that opted in. We'll include tracing hooks for rollback.
Maya (Eng-Platform): I'll add observability dashboards and an alert for KV-cache error rate >0.5%.
Asha (PM): Can leadership confirm whether Optimize beta customers will get early access to the Console cost visuals? @Lee
Lee (VP Product): Yes, Optimize beta gets Console cost-visuals early; we're gating on data retention and eval metrics being available.
Samira (DevEx): I'll schedule a short walkthrough for beta customers on the new cost visuals next month.
Asha (PM): Thanks all. I'll post the compiled timeline + action-item tracker in #product follow-up thread after it's ready. :thumbsup:
